newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds end flat, standstill on U.S. hols.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds end flat, standstill on U.S. hols.

text.p: Argentine bonds finished flat Monday after a session with practically no activity in local bonds due to the New York market closure for Memorial Day.
Literally no trades were recorded on screens, said traders, who anticipated the market's gains could be capped in coming days because of the recent gains.
"I think the market has reached a ceiling for now," said a trader.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was flat at 93 and the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 fell $0.05 to 115.70.
In the money markets, call money rates rose to 5.73 percent from 5.63 percent.
